newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rubber stable in noon trading.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rubber stable in noon trading.

text.p: Indonesian tyre-grade SIR20 rubber prices were mostly stable in noon trading on Wednesday with demand remaining slow, traders said.
They said Singapore dealers bought rubber at 44.75 U.S. cents/lb for July shipment fob Palembang. Offer prices for August shipment was quoted at 45.00 at the centre.
"Market sentiment is poor. We don't have much activity but are waiting for fresh bids. The market also lacks fresh leads which can boost sentiment," said one trader in Padang, West Sumatra.
Traders said offer prices were stable in Medan at 45.50, 45.375 fob Surabaya, fob 45.00 fob Padang and 44.75 fob Pontianak and Jambi.

They said supply was tight in a number of areas, such as Medan, which made traders unwilling to sell at low prices. Traders in Medan have said they can only make a profit if they sell at at least 46.00.
The low rubber prices have also forced tappers to look for jobs elsewhere, traders said.
